description: This Python source file provides utility functions for managing environment variable mappings between common and framework-specific naming conventions, utilizing YAML templates for configuration. It primarily handles file path resolution, YAML parsing, applying prefixes, and bidirectional mapping of environment variables for different frameworks.

methods.name: Path get_template_path(framework: str)
methods.description: Returns the Path object pointing to the env.template file for a specified framework.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Dict[str,str]] parse_template_file(template_path: Path)
methods.description: Reads and parses a YAML template file to extract optional prefix and mapping dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] apply_prefix_mapping(common_env: Dict[str, str], prefix: str)
methods.description: Prefixes all environment variable names in a dictionary with a given string.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_common_to_framework(framework: str, common_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of common env vars into framework-specific env vars based on templates and mappings.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] map_framework_to_common(framework: str, framework_env: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Converts a framework-specific env vars dictionary into common env vars based on templates and mappings.

methods.name: list get_supported_frameworks()
methods.description: Lists all frameworks available based on existing env.template files in subdirectories.
